teaser: Life path 8 carries the pull toward the material world — money, authority, scale. An ISTJ carries the pull toward order and duty, the steady hand that keeps a system running. Put together, the ambition of the 8 stops looking like appetite and starts looking like obligation: power held because someone has to hold it, and this one will not drop it. Neither system alone explains why this pairing tends to build things meant to outlast the builder.
